decision: A Reset button on the tally page that puts the total back to zero.
why: The owner starts a new count by hand today and wants one press.
rejected: resetting only from the command line

decision: Reset removes every stored entry, not only the number on screen.
why: A total that comes back after a reload is not a reset.

decision: The button asks for confirmation before it removes anything.
why: The owner will press it by mistake.

decision: The design in `demo/reset.html`: Reset beside Add in the warning colour; the panel asks "Set the total back to zero? This removes every entry." with Cancel and Reset.
why: The owner opened the page and approved it.
